name: Linear Issues
description: Your Linear issues in Orca's sidebar: everything assigned to you grouped by status, the current cycle, the team's backlog and triage, with issue details, comments and quick changes, plus a status bar count. Works through Orca's own Linear connection, no setup. Not affiliated with Linear.

cover.alt: The panel in Orca's sidebar beside a terminal: made-up issues by status, the branch's issue pinned on top, and the status bar count: 4 in progress, 2 urgent

screenshots.alt: Two panels in Orca's light theme: My issues grouped into In Progress, In Review, Todo and Backlog with the branch's issue pinned on top, and the team backlog
screenshots.caption: Everything assigned to you, grouped by status

screenshots.alt: An issue in Orca's dark theme, its status picker open over the details, next to the same issue scrolled to its sub-issues, links and comments
screenshots.caption: Read, comment, and change status, priority or assignee

screenshots.alt: The current cycle in dark theme with its progress and days left, next to light theme settings: one workspace on an API key, one on Orca's connection
screenshots.caption: The current cycle, with a Linear API key

settings.title: Connection
settings.description: How the plugin reaches Linear. Auto uses Orca's own Linear connection, and a Linear API key for any workspace you added one for in the panel (needed for the current cycle).

settings.title: Refresh every (minutes)
settings.description: How often your issues and the status bar count refresh in the background.

settings.title: Show completed work from the last (days)
settings.description: Completed and canceled issues updated within this many days stay in the list, collapsed at the bottom.

settings.title: Notify me of new assignments
settings.description: Show a desktop notification when an issue is newly assigned to you.

settings.title: Orca CLI path
settings.description: Only if the plugin cannot find Orca's command line tool on its own, for example /Applications/Orca.app/Contents/Resources/bin/orca.
